facts.big: He said he’d call me back
facts.label: Discurso indireto
facts.sub: Use said ou told me + that e volte o verbo: will vira would, is vira was. He said he would call.

facts.label: disse que
facts.sub: Use said (that) + frase com o verbo no passado: He said (that) he was busy. She said (that) she would call. Não coloque a pessoa depois de said, a não ser com to: He said to me.

facts.label: me disse que
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa + that + frase: He told me that he was busy. Depois de told, coloque sempre a pessoa: told me, told him, told her. Não use told that sozinho.

compare.ask: He said he would call me back.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ele disse que ligaria” e “ela me falou que estava ocupada”.
compare.tip: Diga: “He said he would call me back.”
compare.us: Em inglês, volte o verbo no tempo: will vira would, is vira was, am going to vira was going to. Use told me + that ou said + that: He told me that he was busy. He said that he would call. Não use told sem pessoa.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: He said he would call me back.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: He said he would call is a way to report a promise.
We say “He told that he was busy.”
items.why: We say He told me that he was busy, or He said that he was busy.

items.s: After told, we usually put a person.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: He said he would call is a way to report a promise. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He told that he was busy.” → Falso (We say He told me that he was busy, or He said that he was busy.)
After told, we usually put a person. → Verdadeiro (He told me.)

pages.title: Messages for Sara · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot afternoon in Dallas. Sara walks into a phone store. Her friend Dana works at the desk. Dana has some news for her. Several people called Sara today. Dana wrote down every message.

“Sara, your brother left a voicemail. He said he would call you back.” says Dana. “Did he say why he called? He told me he was busy yesterday.” says Sara. “He said that he needed your new number. I told him you changed it.” says Dana.
